description: Walks a table of 12-byte records and, when a stored field is below the value supplied in a data register, shifts the records from that position down by one entry to make room. It uses BCD adjustment on a global counter while scanning.

name: pass_through_call_wrapper
description: Calls one routine and returns, with no other logic. It is a pass-through wrapper.

name: run_name_entry_input_loop
description: Loops on a vertical beam position timing window and processes input codes: some move a cursor in a five-slot text buffer, one copies a template into it, and any other code is stored as a character. Decoded input codes are looked up in a table at a fixed address.

name: clear_indexed_byte_and_global
description: Writes zero to a byte selected by a global index value, then clears that global to zero.

name: run_six_pass_call_sequence
description: Calls one routine, then calls another routine six times in a loop, and finishes with three more calls. No other logic appears in the shown code.

name: call_two_routines_in_order
description: Calls two routines in sequence and returns. It has no other logic.

name: write_cia_timer_config_values
description: Writes a fixed sequence of six values to a global variable. The listed CIA timer and interrupt control registers suggest it configures the CIA timers, but the shown code only stores the values.

name: compute_rotated_inverted_byte
description: Reads a global byte, writes all ones, then stores a rotated inverted copy of the original byte and writes two fixed values. The listed keyboard serial register is named in the facts but is not accessed in the shown code.

name: loop_ten_bcd_steps_calls
description: Runs ten passes, each adjusting a BCD counter from one to ten and calling routines five times in an inner loop before three more calls. The shown code does not write the background colour register directly.

name: stub_self_assignment_four_writes
description: Writes a global variable to itself four times, which has no effect, and returns. The listed DMA and interrupt enable read registers are not accessed in the shown code.

name: flush_pending_bit_values
description: Checks a pending value word and, when it is non-zero, writes it to a global and stores nine for each set low-order bit. When a second pending flag is set it writes five stored values to the global variable and clears the flag.

name: reset_state_and_default_values
description: Clears two state words, calls four routines, then writes zeroes and two fixed values, 15 and 1920, into the global variable. It is a reset sequence for the state block.

name: store_input_byte_and_call
description: Stores the low byte of its data register input in a state byte and then calls one routine.

name: decode_event_byte_into_channel
description: Decodes an incoming event byte and updates a per-channel record. Some codes set fields directly, while others store a value from a lookup table and mark the channel as active; the routine returns its input unchanged.

name: initialise_channel_state_tables
description: Stores several pointers and offsets derived from its input, then clears a 32-entry table of words and sets default values in it. It finishes by storing pointers to the lookup tables.

name: reset_audio_state_and_defaults
description: Clears two state words, calls four routines, then writes zeroes and two fixed values, 15 and 1920, into the global variable. The listed audio period registers suggest it resets the audio channel state.

name: decrement_timer_and_wait_flag
description: Decrements a 16-bit timer in a record and, when it goes negative, reloads it from a global value and calls routines in a nested loop until a flag byte is zero. Otherwise it returns without action.

name: interpret_sequence_command_byte
description: Reads a command byte from a sequence and dispatches on its low nibble. It can stop the sequence, set field values, change the position for loops and jumps, or advance a step counter for data bytes.

name: mark_channel_ended_and_advance
description: Marks a channel record as ended, advances a counter in a paired word with wraparound back to a start value, calls one routine and sets the flag to all ones. It is a short tail section of the sequence interpreter.

name: interpret_sequence_command_entry
description: An alternate entry into the sequence command interpreter that first handles a countdown before dispatching commands. It reads command bytes, dispatches on their low nibble, and ends on the terminating command, with the same effect as the main dispatcher.

name: interpret_sequence_command_from_table
description: Loads a channel position from a table indexed by a data byte, then dispatches the next sequence command by its low nibble. Commands cover loops, jumps, field updates and the terminating command.

name: set_field_and_advance_step
description: Stores a byte from the frame into a channel field and increments the channel's step counter, then returns.

name: set_channel_status_all_ones
description: Sets a status byte in a channel record to all ones and returns.

name: interpret_sequence_commands_loop
description: Loops over sequence command bytes for a channel, advancing the step counter and dispatching on the low nibble of each byte. Commands cover loops, jumps, field updates and the terminating command that returns.

name: start_sequence_at_table_position
description: Saves the channel's current position and step into backup fields, loads a new position from a table, and dispatches the command byte at that point. Dispatch covers loops, jumps, field updates and the terminating command.

name: dispatch_sequence_command_entry
description: Sets the channel's position from a table indexed by a masked value, then dispatches the next sequence command by its low nibble. Commands cover loops, jumps, field updates and the terminating command.

name: set_channel_status_inactive
description: Sets a status byte in a channel record to all ones and returns.

name: save_position_then_dispatch_command
description: Copies the channel's current position and step into backup fields, then loads the next position from a table and dispatches the command byte there.

name: decode_channel_word_group
description: Reads a group of up to six words from a sequence and stores each into channel fields. A special marker word calls a routine from a table, while other words set a position and a flag.

name: clear_channel_field_byte
description: Clears a byte at a field offset in a channel record and returns.

name: clear_channel_field_byte
description: Clears a byte at a field offset in a channel record and returns.

name: tick_channel_timer_and_flags
description: Decrements a timer in a channel record, clears two flag bytes when the timer was already negative, and clears a pending flag. It then calls a routine when that pending flag was set.

name: clear_channel_flag_bytes_step
description: Decrements a countdown in a channel record and clears its flag bytes when they are set. It then reads the next value through a stored pointer and calls routines based on it, with the shape of a per-tick channel update.

name: advance_channel_step_and_dispatch
description: Clears a few channel fields and advances the step counter. When a flag byte is zero it reads the next sequence value and dispatches it through a jump table entry.

name: dispatch_channel_table_command
description: Copies two words into the channel state, increments a step counter, then reads the next sequence value and dispatches it through a jump table.

name: store_channel_offset_and_dispatch
description: Stores the sum of two frame values in the channel record and a pointer slot, increments the step counter, and dispatches the next sequence value through a jump table.

name: store_channel_word_and_dispatch
description: Copies a frame word into two channel fields, increments the step counter, and dispatches the next sequence value through a jump table.

name: hold_channel_and_dispatch_next
description: When a hold flag is clear, sets it and advances the step counter. Otherwise it counts down the held value, then dispatches the next sequence command through a jump table.

name: countdown_channel_hold_and_dispatch
description: Counts down a held value in a channel record, or sets the hold flag and advances the step counter when it is clear. It then dispatches the next sequence command through a jump table.

name: start_channel_from_record_pointer
description: Builds a channel base pointer from a record and a table, sets step fields and a flag, then loads the first sequence value and dispatches it.

name: advance_channel_repeat_and_step
description: Updates a channel on each tick by adding a step value to its position and counting down a repeat count. When the count reaches zero it reloads the count and reverses the step, and it handles a secondary flag before returning.

name: set_scaled_table_value_dispatch
description: Looks up a value in a 64-entry table using a frame byte plus a channel offset, scales it by an adjustment and stores it in the channel. It then dispatches the next sequence command through a jump table.

name: look_up_table_value_dispatch
description: Looks up a value in a 64-entry table using a frame byte plus a channel offset, stores it in the channel, and then dispatches the next sequence command through a jump table.

name: reset_channel_fields_and_dispatch
description: Clears several channel fields, advances the step counter, and dispatches the next sequence command through a jump table.

name: store_scaled_byte_and_dispatch
description: Stores a computed byte made from a frame byte and a channel value into the channel, advances the step counter, and dispatches the next sequence command through a jump table.

name: store_frame_byte_and_dispatch
description: Copies a frame byte into a channel field, advances the step counter, and dispatches the next sequence command through a jump table.

name: store_four_bytes_and_dispatch
description: Copies four frame bytes into channel fields, advances the step counter, and dispatches the next sequence command through a jump table.

name: count_down_hold_and_dispatch
description: Counts down a hold value in a channel record, or sets the hold flag when it is clear. It then dispatches the next sequence command through a jump table.

name: add_word_position_dispatch
description: Sets two channel fields from a frame byte, adds a frame word to a running position, stores the result, and dispatches the next sequence command.

name: accumulate_word_and_dispatch
description: Adds a frame word to a channel accumulator, stores the result in two places, advances the step counter and dispatches the next sequence command through a jump table.

name: update_channel_hold_and_step
description: Counts down a hold value in a channel record, or handles the hold flag when it is set, and then sets the position from a table. It dispatches the next sequence command through a jump table.

name: save_position_load_table_entry
description: Saves the channel's current position and step into backup fields, then loads a new position from a table and dispatches the command at that point.

name: advance_position_by_frame_long
description: Adds a frame longword to a channel position, stores the new position and a half-step value, advances the step counter and dispatches the next sequence command.

name: set_position_from_frame_long
description: Sets a channel position from a frame longword, sets two fields to one, advances the step counter and dispatches the next sequence command through a jump table.

name: set_channel_hold_and_dispatch
description: Sets a channel field from a frame byte, applies hold logic to a second field, and dispatches the next sequence command through a jump table.

name: hold_channel_or_toggle_interrupts
description: Holds or counts down a channel's timer in the same way as the other command handlers, then dispatches the next sequence command. The listed interrupt and DMA registers are touched through the routines it calls.

name: accumulate_word_and_dispatch
description: Adds a frame word to a channel accumulator, stores the result in two places, advances the step counter and dispatches the next sequence command through a jump table.

name: toggle_channel_hold_and_dispatch
description: Clears a channel timer field and sets a hold flag, then dispatches the next sequence command through a jump table. The listed interrupt enable register is touched through the routines it calls.

name: select_channel_status_tick
description: Chooses one of three channel records according to bits in a status word, decrements that record's timer, and marks it inactive when the timer goes negative.

name: compare_and_branch_sequence_command
description: Compares a frame byte with a channel byte, then either stores a frame word as the new position or advances the step counter. It then dispatches the next sequence command through a jump table.

name: countdown_channel_hold_and_dispatch
description: Counts down a held value in a channel record, or sets the hold flag and advances the step counter when it is clear. It then dispatches the next sequence command through a jump table.

name: set_channel_flag_and_dispatch
description: Sets a flag byte in a channel record to all ones, advances the step counter, and dispatches the next sequence command through a jump table.

name: set_channel_counter_and_dispatch
description: Sets a counter field in a channel record from a frame byte minus one, stores a frame word as the new position, and dispatches the next sequence command through a jump table.

name: count_down_hold_and_dispatch
description: Counts down a hold value in a channel record, or sets the hold flag when it is clear. It then dispatches the next sequence command through a jump table.

name: look_up_scaled_table_entry
description: Looks up a value in a 64-entry table using a frame byte plus a different channel offset, scales it by an adjustment and stores it in the channel. It then handles a hold flag and dispatches the next sequence command through a jump table.

name: store_frame_word_and_dispatch
description: Stores a frame word into two channel fields, advances the step counter, and dispatches the next sequence command through a jump table.

name: reset_channel_fields_and_dispatch
description: Clears several channel fields, advances the step counter, and dispatches the next sequence command through a jump table.

name: save_position_load_table_entry
description: Saves the channel's current position and step into backup fields, then loads a new position from a table and dispatches the command at that point.

name: restore_position_and_dispatch
description: Restores the channel's saved position and step from backup fields, advances the step counter and dispatches the next sequence command through a jump table.

name: decode_event_byte_into_channel
description: Decodes an incoming event byte and updates a per-channel record. Some codes set fields directly, while others store a value from a lookup table and mark the channel as active; the routine returns its input unchanged.

name: compare_stored_byte_set_flag
description: Compares an input byte with a stored byte when a second value is non-zero. It sets the flag to one or to all ones depending on which is smaller, and otherwise copies the input into the stored byte and clears the flag.

name: copy_field_and_clear_flag
description: Copies a byte from one channel field to another and clears a flag byte in the same record.

name: clear_record_byte_and_longword
description: Clears a byte and a longword in a channel record and returns.

name: reset_state_and_default_values
description: Clears two state words, calls four routines, then writes zeroes and two fixed values, 15 and 1920, into the global variable. It is a reset sequence for the state block.

name: store_flagged_word_and_call
description: Stores its data register input, with bit eight set, into a global word, then calls one routine.

name: update_channel_table_entry
description: Copies a table word selected by a record field into a second table slot and updates two state words. The listed fire-button and disk status register is reached only through the routines it calls.

name: stub_empty_return

name: initialise_sixteen_byte_sentinel_table

name: set_fixed_longword_record_address

name: dispatch_indexed_routine_with_wait
description: Checks an index in a data register against a range of ten; an invalid index waits for a global status bit to clear and set, then returns a failure value. A valid index looks up a pointer table entry, calls three routines in turn, and returns the index on success.

name: start_indexed_entry_when_idle
description: Returns zero at once when the indexed table flag is set. Otherwise it calls routines, stores a 64-bit result in two global words, and when a further call succeeds it marks the entry active and calls another routine; on failure it clears the entry and returns a fail value.
